jerusalem.linePrev: But I believe there'll come a day when the lion and the lamb
jerusalem.line: Will lie down in peace together in Jerusalem
jerusalem.lineNext: And there'll be no barricades then, there'll be no wire walls
stanza: Then the storm comes rumbling in and I can't lay me down
And the drums are drumming again and I can't stand the sound
But I believe there'll come a day when the lion and the lamb
Will lie down in peace together in Jerusalem

jerusalem.linePrev: That I believe that one fine day, all the children of Abraham
jerusalem.line: Will lay down their swords forever in Jerusalem
jerusalem.lineNext: Well, maybe I'm only dreaming and maybe I'm just a fool
stanza: I almost listened to him, yeah, I almost lost my mind
Then I regained my senses again and looked into my heart to find
That I believe that one fine day, all the children of Abraham
Will lay down their swords forever in Jerusalem
